prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Revathi R, Raju bhai.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 10:45 am and 11:22 am: 7 messages
- between 11:22 am and 11:51 am: 5 messages
- between 11:51 am and 12:01 pm: 1 messages
- between 12:01 pm and 1:15 pm: 15 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "10:46 am", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Raju bhai chai peene chalein kya abhi?"},
  {"time": "10:50 am", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Haan bilkul, thoda kaam nipta raha tha."},
  {"time": "10:55 am", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Sahi hai, niche wale stall par milte hain."},
  {"time": "11:02 am", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Waha pichhle hafte ka hisab bhi baaki tha na?"},
  {"time": "11:10 am", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Haan woh jo humne nashta kiya tha tabka."},
  {"time": "11:15 am", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Wahi baat kar lenge, tum chinta mat karo."},
  {"time": "11:20 am", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Bas thodi der mein niche pahunch rahi hoon."},
  {"time": "11:25 am", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Main pahunch gaya hoon, chai order kar di hai."},
  {"time": "11:32 am", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Arey wah, main bhi bas aa hi gayi."},
  {"time": "11:38 am", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Baaki logon ko bhi bulana tha kya meeting ke liye?"},
  {"time": "11:43 am", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Nahi abhi hum dono hi baat kar lete hain."},
  {"time": "11:48 am", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Sahi hai, sukoon se baat ho jayegi."},
  {"time": "11:55 am", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Waise pichli baar wala saara hisab barabar ho gaya tha na?"},
  {"time": "12:03 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Haan bas thoda sa bacha hua hai abhi."},
  {"time": "12:08 pm", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Koi baat nahi, shaam ko dekh lenge use."},
  {"time": "12:15 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Thik hai, waise aaj ka khana kahan khayein?"},
  {"time": "12:20 pm", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Naye wale dhabe par chalte hain."},
  {"time": "12:28 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Wahan thoda mehnga hai par khana accha hai."},
  {"time": "12:35 pm", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Chalega, aaj mera treat samjho."},
  {"time": "12:40 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Waah, ye to bohot acchi baat hai."},
  {"time": "12:45 pm", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Agli baar tumhara number hoga waise."},
  {"time": "12:50 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Haan haan, mujhe yaad rahega."},
  {"time": "12:55 pm", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Chalo abhi office ka kaam khatam kar lete hain."},
  {"time": "1:00 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Haan, dopahar ke lunch ke time milte hain."},
  {"time": "1:04 pm", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Tab tak purana hisab samjh lenge."},
  {"time": "1:08 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Bilkul koi jaldbaazi nahi hai."},
  {"time": "1:11 pm", "sender": "Revathi R", "text": "Thik hai phir, lunch par milte hain."},
  {"time": "1:14 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Okay, seedhe reception par milenge."}
]
